description:
Enhance the product listing for 'Wireless Bluetooth Headphones' (SKU: WBH-001) by adding visual assets. 

1. Navigate to the product edit page in the WooCommerce admin panel.
2. Upload and set 'headphones_main.jpg' (located in ~/Documents/ProductPhotos/) as the **Product Image**.
3. Upload and add 'headphones_lifestyle.jpg' (located in ~/Documents/ProductPhotos/) to the **Product Gallery**.
4. Update the product to save your changes.
